A '''clone trooper commander''' served under [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Tohno]]. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] organized the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces on [[Zaadja/Legends|Zaadja]] in preparation for the assault on the [[Zaadja droid manufacturing center|droid manufacturing center]]. The commander subsequently oversaw Republic forces alongside Skywalker and Kenobi, while Tohno infiltrated the center and sacrificed herself to destroy it. The commander wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] markings.<ref name="Republic 67" />
